@@ -35,1 +35,35 @@
-# the main GPT text split patterns, see
+def _split_specials(text, special):
+    # same as re.split("(" + "|".join(map(re.escape, special)) + ")", text)
+    # for non-empty str tokens, without compiling a pattern: the leftmost
+    # occurrence wins, ties go to the first token (alternation order)
+    toks = list(special)
+    if not all(type(t) is str and t for t in toks):
+        return re.split("(" + "|".join(re.escape(k) for k in special) + ")", text)
+    find = text.find
+    nxt = [find(t) for t in toks]
+    out = []
+    start = 0
+    n = len(toks)
+    while True:
+        best = -1
+        bi = 0
+        for i in range(n):
+            p = nxt[i]
+            if p >= 0 and (best < 0 or p < best):
+                best = p
+                bi = i
+        if best < 0:
+            break
+        tok = toks[bi]
+        end = best + len(tok)
+        out.append(text[start:best])
+        out.append(tok)
+        start = end
+        for i in range(n):
+            if 0 <= nxt[i] < end:
+                nxt[i] = find(toks[i], end)
+    out.append(text[start:])
+    return out
+
